entries.en: For far, far too long have I waited for this rematch!
entries.fr: J'ai tant attendu le jour de notre face-à-face !
entries.ja: こうして戦える日を ずっと待っていたぞ！
entries.frMacro: J'ai tant attendu le jour de notre face-à-face<nbsp>!
entries.speaker: YOJINBO

entries.en:
The Soboro Sukehiro may have brought us together, but 'twas fate that
ordained we engage in glorious fisticuffs─but with swords!─once more!
entries.macro:
The Soboro Sukehiro may have brought us together, but 'twas fate that
ordained we engage in glorious fisticuffs─but with swords!─once more!
entries.fr: Réglons cette affaire de Soboro-sukehiro... et décidons qui est le plus fort de nous deux, une bonne fois pour toutes !
entries.ja:
ソボロ助広の件、決着をつけさせてもらうぞ。
……というよりも、因縁の対決といこうじゃないか！

entries.en: Victory will be mine this day!
entries.speaker: YOJINBO

entries.en: I throw myself upon your boundless mercy and beg forgiveness! Please!
entries.ja: オレの負けだ……このとおり 勘弁してくれぃ……！
